identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a professional, high-density enterprise admin platform for SalonBookin that balances aesthetic appeal with operational efficiency.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss precision with Fintech trust.
Content is King: Data density and clarity are paramount for admin ops.
Contrast: High contrast for readability and hierarchy.
Negative Space: Use breathing room to prevent cognitive overload in dense data views.

headings.usage: Page titles, card headers, modal titles. DO NOT use Inter for headings.

body.usage: General text, table data, form labels.

mono.usage: Terminal IDs, API keys, Transaction hashes, IP addresses.

rules: Overlines/Labels must be Uppercase + text-xs + tracking-wider.
Table data must be legible (text-sm) with tabular-nums for figures.

primary.name: Enterprise Blue
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, key links.

colors.theme_strategy: Light mode content area with a permanent Dark mode sidebar (Navy/Slate). This creates a professional 'Control Room' aesthetic.

rules: Content Area: Max-width 1600px centered, p-6 or p-8.
Dashboard Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6.
Cards: h-full for uniform height in grid rows.

cards.style: Flat, white background, 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), minimal shadow (shadow-sm).
cards.header: Distinct header area with border-b for complex cards.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-sm rounded-md (not pill).
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-input hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground rounded-md.

tables.style: Dense, clean rows. Header row with bg-muted/50. Cell padding p-3.
tables.features: Sticky header, pagination footer, row hover state (bg-muted/50).

sidebar.style: Dark Navy background. Links: text-slate-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 rounded-md p-2 transition-colors.

visual_enhancers: Subtle noise texture on the dark sidebar for depth (optional).
Status badges: Soft background + dark text (e.g., bg-green-100 text-green-800).
Empty States: Use clean SVG illustrations or Lucide icons with gray circles.

assets.icons: Use Lucide React (lucide-react). Default icon set.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Update 'src/index.css' to implement the Enterprise Blue and Dark Sidebar variables. Ensure the sidebar is permanently dark mode while the main content is light.
3. FONTS: Add Manrope and Inter via Google Fonts import in 'src/index.css'.
4. LAYOUT: Create a 'Layout' component with a fixed Sidebar and scrollable Main Content area.
5. COMPONENTS: Customize Shadcn components to match the 'Professional Enterprise' aesthetic (sharper corners, dense spacing).
6. DASHBOARD: Build the 'Bento' grid for the dashboard using the provided stats and charts logic.
7. TABLES: Implement robust data tables for Merchants and Terminals with status badges and action menus.
8. FORMS: Use Shadcn Form for the VAR Sheet upload and Terminal provisioning flows.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic gradients or centered layouts.
Micro-interactions: Add hover states to all rows and buttons.
Data Density: Do not waste space. This is an admin tool. Use dense layouts.
Accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios are met, especially blue text on white.
Testing: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements.
